## 6 Shipped Production Projects
1. **Cloud Support & Customer Engineering Simulation**
   - *Focus:* Cloud Networking, Mutual TLS (mTLS), Secure Remote Access, Disaster Recovery.
   - *Architecture:* AWS Client VPN (mTLS) + SSM Session Manager for private VPC subnet access without public bastions, CloudWatch Logs Insights, and point-in-time recovery with AWS Backup.
   - *GitHub:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/AWS-Client-VPN-End-to-End-Setup-and-Troubleshooting

2. **Cloud Security Observability Stack on ECS Fargate**
   - *Focus:* Observability, Time-Series Telemetry, Serverless Containers.
   - *Architecture:* Terraform-provisioned container monitoring pipeline on AWS ECS Fargate scraping secure Spring Boot actuator endpoints into Prometheus TSDB with Grafana dashboards and alert rules.
   - *GitHub:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/Cloud-Security-Observability-Stack-on-ECS-Fargate

3. **AI Test Generator & GitOps Delivery Pipeline**
   - *Focus:* Declarative GitOps, Continuous Delivery, Kubernetes Orchestration.
   - *Architecture:* FastAPI + Groq LLaMA 3.1 microservice. Automated Jenkins pipeline compiles, runs tests, builds Docker images, pushes to AWS ECR, and commits image tags to a GitOps repository reconciled by ArgoCD on Kubernetes.
   - *App Repo:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/FastAPI-Groq-AI-Test-Generator-CI-CD
   - *GitOps Manifests Repo:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/gitops-infra-manifests

4. **Self-Healing Java Microservice on AWS**
   - *Focus:* High Availability, 5-Layer Auto-Recovery, DevSecOps.
   - *Architecture:* Spring Boot service behind AWS ALB with target health tracking, EC2 Auto Scaling Groups (2-4 instances), automated instance replacement, and Snyk SAST/SCA security gates in GitHub Actions.
   - *GitHub:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/java-self-healing-microservice

5. **AI Patient Triage System on Azure**
   - *Focus:* Cloud-Native Healthcare Decision Support, Telemetry.
   - *Architecture:* Python Flask microservice hosted on Azure App Service (Linux, Gunicorn) integrated with Azure OpenAI GPT-4o for real-time clinical triage classification with immutable audit logs stored in Azure Table Storage and monitored via Azure Monitor.
   - *GitHub:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/AI-Patient-Triage-System-on-Azure-CSA-Case-Study-

6. **Bookstore Serverless Architecture on AWS**
   - *Focus:* Serverless Microservices, Cloud Cost Optimization.
   - *Architecture:* AWS Lambda compute (Node.js 20.x), Amazon API Gateway HTTP routing, and MongoDB Atlas database. Operates at $0/month idle operational cost with automated on-demand scaling.
   - *GitHub:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/Bookstore-Microservice-Architecture-on-AWS

7. **Cloud Compliance & Vendor Risk Management Lab**
   - *Focus:* Enterprise IaC Security Governance, Continuous Compliance, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).
   - *Architecture:* Terraform provisions continuous compliance auditing via AWS Config and AWS Security Hub (CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0). Captures non-compliant events via Amazon EventBridge, enriches failed controls with ISO 27001:2022 and NIST CSF v1.1 crosswalks using an AWS Lambda logger, builds a live consolidated S3 Risk Register (JSON/CSV), and features a CLI TPRM vendor scoring engine with a self-hosted GRC portal (Docker Compose).
   - *GitHub:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/cloud-compliance-vendor-risk

8. **Identity Threat Detection & Response Lab (Vault + Wazuh on AWS)**
   - *Focus:* Identity Security, Detection Engineering, SOC Incident Response, MITRE ATT&CK.
   - *Architecture:* HashiCorp Vault 1.15 Community dynamic JIT IAM user generation (900s TTL auto-deletion) paired with single-node Wazuh 4.7.5 SIEM on AWS (t3.large provisioned via Terraform). Ingests real-time host auth telemetry (/var/log/auth.log) and AWS CloudTrail management events via S3 wodle. Verified 33 custom detection alerts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques (T1110 password guessing/spraying, T1548 sudo abuse escalation, T1078/T1098 IAM persistence) with actionable SOC containment runbooks.
   - *GitHub:* https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/identity-threat-detection-lab
